name: Blinding Gale (1/Day)
description: The creature unleashes a blinding burst of wind in a 20-foot radius centered on itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, becoming blinded on a failed save for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
